2026-07-10/intercom-avocado-shopping-beg.notes: run.js's per-turn reply delta (common-prefix scan vs the pre-send transcript) breaks on Intercom's live-updating relative timestamps ("Just now" -> "1m" -> "2m") on already-sent messages: the drift trips the char-compare within the first ~100 chars, the 70% common-prefix gate never clears, and every turn from roughly turn 5 onward falls back to the WHOLE accumulated transcript, replaying prior turns as the "new" reply (capped at 4000 chars from the front, so later real answers are silently dropped). Fixed in run.js (position-mapped timestamp normalization before the diff) 2026-07-13; excluded pending a clean rerun.
